Configuration

Whispy reads ~/.config/whispy/config.json when it starts. Every key is optional: anything missing falls back to its default, and an invalid value is replaced by the default with a note in the log. When Whispy saves a setting, it changes that key only and leaves every other key as it found it.

On macOS every key below is also in the menu bar menu, where a change applies to the next dictation without a restart.

On Linux, edit the file, then restart Whispy: systemctl --user restart whispy2. On Omarchy, pick the dictation key in the Whispy bar panel instead.

Config builder

Set the values you want and copy the result. Only the keys you changed are shown; merge them into your existing config.json, then restart Whispy.

This builder needs JavaScript. Without it, use the reference table below to write the JSON by hand.

Reference

KeyDefaultAccepted valuesPlatformsDescription
Typing
copy_to_clipboardtruetrue / falsemacOSmacOS: paste the text through the clipboard (⌘V) and put the previous clipboard back; false types it key by key and leaves the clipboard alone. Linux always types the text.
Trigger
trigger_mode"hold"hold or togglemacOS, Linuxhold: record while the key is held. toggle: one press starts, the next press stops.
type_while_speakingtruetrue / falsemacOS, LinuxToggle mode only: type the words while you speak, about two seconds behind your voice, instead of all at once at the stop.
triggernullnull (Fn) or a keycodemacOSmacOS: the trigger key. Empty for Fn, or a keycode: 54 Right Command, 61 Right Option, 105 F13 (all in the menu). Linux under X11 always uses Right Ctrl; under Wayland your compositor binds the key.
Interface
language"system"system or fr or enmacOS, LinuxThe language of Whispy's menus and notifications. system: French when the system is in French (macOS: the first preferred language; Linux: LC_ALL, LC_MESSAGES, then LANG), English otherwise. fr or en forces one. Also in the menu: Language.
Omarchy
omarchy_trigger"right_option_hold"right_option_hold or right_ctrl_hold or f9_hold or left_option_space_toggleLinuxOmarchy: the dictation key, written by the Whispy bar panel (pick it there: it also rewrites ~/.config/whispy/shortcuts.lua and reloads Hyprland).

On macOS you can also choose the trigger from the menu bar (Settings → Trigger): Fn, Right Command, Right Option or F13. The change applies immediately.
